blocks.heading: How to Order Books
blocks.lead: Steps for those who would like printed copies

items.title: Choose your books
items.body: Check the titles and prices in the Office's publications list

items.title: Fill in the order form
items.body: Specify the titles, quantities and delivery address

items.title: Make payment
items.body: Pay by money order or by transfer to the Siam Commercial Bank account named "Office of the Royal Society (Book Sales Room)"

items.title: Receive your books
items.body: Staff will ship the books once payment for the books and shipping has been received

blocks.title: Reprinting publications
blocks.body: Reprinting or redistributing the Office's content or publications requires prior permission. See the procedure on the Academic Services page.
